name: Default
shortDescription: Self-contained Go web server that serves a persistent site directory and renders Markdown, Lua, Pongo2, JSX and TypeScript pages on the fly, with built-in users and permissions.

alerts.message: This image runs on x86_64 servers only.

Algernon starts with an empty site and shows a directory listing until you add your files to the algernon-site volume (/srv/algernon). An index.lua, index.html or index.md there becomes the front page.
